_comment: The SHAPE v4 — the Oazoor spend: drop basses are riff-bank walks (each bar a different skeleton over one chord bank), a sine sub pyramid locks underneath, and drop II's walk ends on a held bar — the bass exhales into the confession. The sneeze now lands after a bar of TRUE silence (deer look up — comedy timing; it was camouflaged against the riser's noise crest). Drops shortened 8+8 → 4+4 with a melodic clearing between; wobble replaced by techno bass + the motif as lead. The outro grows a litany: 'i sneezed' / 'not allowed' trading two-bar lines before the full apology.
